decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - A full record including annotated photographs and drawings should be made during the opening up and reconstruction process. This should be formed into a log book and retained for future reference.
Condition : 3 - Re-use as much as possible of existing features such as tiles, and in particular if the main valley beam is in good enough condition it should be re-incorporated into the structure

Condition : 4 - Detailed drawings of the proposed method of opening up, structural intervention and supports and subsequent effect on the structure and construction of the building including details of works to comply with building regulations, of the hereby permitted roof extension, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval given.

Condition : 5 - Details to a scale of 1:20 and samples of materials of the new roof/wall coverings, windows, doors, staircase, rooflights and any openings for waste removal and ventilation, of the hereby permitted roof extension, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval given.

Condition : 6 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Erection of a roof extension to the house
